summary: Tested P0 memory-optimization fixes for IHEZA. All 8 backend tests passed and all frontend flows verified: health endpoint, /users/chains route (no shadowing), /sync?counts_only=true returns int counts, /sync full mode paginated (page_size capped at 1000), /staff-tasks?task_status=pending works (renamed param no longer shadows fastapi.status), DUP Principal login OK, homepage loads without errors, mobile 375px viewport has no horizontal scroll, /chain/DUP landing page renders correctly, and login → /portal/dashboard integration works.
passed_tests: GET /api/users/chains -> 200 returns list (route shadowing fixed; static route before /users/{user_id})
GET /api/sync?counts_only=true -> returns integer counts for users/students/classes/subjects (no arrays)
GET /api/sync full mode -> returns paginated arrays with pagination metadata
POST /api/auth login for DUP Principal -> 200 with sessionToken
Homepage loads (title: IHEZA School Management System) with all 8 portal cards
Mobile viewport 375x667: scrollWidth==clientWidth==375, no horizontal scroll
/chain/DUP landing page renders Deniz Upper Primary with portal selection
Principal login via UI navigates to /portal/dashboard and displays dashboard (99 students, 11 staff, 7 classes, 9 subjects)
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 7827 lines - should be split into routers by domain (auth, users, students, sync, staff-tasks, etc.) for maintainability.
Login response uses 'sessionToken' key while many clients expect 'token'/'access_token' - consider adding an alias for consistency.
/api/users/chains is intentionally unauthenticated (comment says 'temporarily allow') - should be revisited as it may leak chain metadata.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Login endpoint is POST /api/auth (NOT /api/auth/login) and requires body {accessCode, password, portal}. Response returns 'sessionToken' (not 'token'). /users/chains is a static route defined BEFORE /users/{user_id} - keep this order. /sync accepts counts_only=true for lightweight polling; page_size is capped at 1000. staff-tasks uses task_status query param (renamed from status to avoid shadowing fastapi.status import).
